title: Guilds of Ravnica Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Libuse
entities.description: A Boros sergeant who speaks wryly of the lockup.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A Ravnican guild with military ranks such as sergeant.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: A figure who speaks of inner peace and trust reviving what hatred destroys.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane, beneath whose streets lie tunnels, caverns, waterways and terrors.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: A figure with intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Golgari shaman.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnican guild with shamans and crops, which has a new kingdom under a queen.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: Assassins who distill toxins from the remains of previous victims.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: A Ravnican street known for festival crowds.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A self-described soul of battle who advises against open war with the Conclave.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that has evangels and temples.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild facing a power vacuum.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A figure who takes a keepsake from the Azorius power vacuum.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A figure whose mystical storm detects Planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.

entities.name: Thousand-Year Storm
entities.description: Ral's storm, crackling with mystical detections of Planeswalkers.

entities.name: Commander Yaszen
entities.description: A commander who promises recruits will be forged rather than trained.

entities.name: Zija
entities.description: A Simic mutationist wary of a new Izzet building project.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild with mutationists.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: A Ravnican guild undertaking a massive new building project with an unstated purpose.

entities.name: Niszka
entities.description: A Selesnya evangel.

entities.name: Duskmantle
entities.description: A place few believe exists; none who find it live to bear witness.

events.summary: Lazav reports intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.
events.quote: We have intel that some guilds have fallen under an invader's influence.

events.summary: A power vacuum opens for the Azorius, and Vraska gains a keepsake.
events.quote: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.

events.summary: Ral's storm detects Planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.
events.quote: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

events.summary: The Izzet begin a massive new building project with an unstated purpose.
events.quote: A massive new Izzet building project with an unstated purpose?

relations.quote: Ral's storm crackled with mystical detections
